people.name: Mary
people.line: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet.

translations.web: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
translations.bsb: After Martha had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside to tell her, “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”
translations.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
translations.asv: And when she had said this, she went away, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Teacher is her, and calleth thee.
